resources.string: MKV to MP4
Turns MKV files into MP4s that play on Google TV and Chromecast. Video is copied as is when it can be (fast, no quality loss), otherwise re-encoded; audio becomes AAC.
Choose MKV files
Convert a whole folder
Every MKV in the folder and its subfolders is converted. Files already in the output folder are skipped, so you can run the same folder again later to do just the new ones.
Save to
Change output folder
Use default
Streaming limit (video bitrate)
Video above the limit is re-encoded under it so it doesn\'t stutter on the dongle. Copying is fast; re-encoding a movie takes a while.
6 Mbps: weak or 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, or the TV is far from the router
10 Mbps: recommended for Chromecast / Google TV dongles
20 Mbps: strong 5 GHz Wi-Fi or Ethernet
No limit: keep the original quality, never re-encode for size
Max compatibility: also re-encode HEVC to H.264 and mix audio to stereo (much slower, for older TVs and dongles)
Re-encoding quality
Fast: the phone\'s hardware encoder. Quickest, but softer and blockier
Quality: clean picture, a few times slower than Fast (recommended)

Only matters when video has to be re-encoded (over the streaming limit, or a format Google TV can\'t play). Copied video is always full quality. The streaming limit matters most: 20 Mbps looks much better than 10 if your Wi-Fi can take it.
Keep subtitles (SRT / ASS text subtitles only; off leaves all subtitles out)
Cancel
Nothing converting.
